game.title: Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Machine Games, released 2017-10-25. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The opening choice, the hidden story milestones and beating the game. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Beating the game on each difficulty, up to "Mein leben".

chapters.title: Collectibles
chapters.summary: Max's toys, records, gold, Übercommander death cards, starcards and concept art.

chapters.title: Weapons, Perks and Contraptions
chapters.summary: Weapon upgrades, maxing perks, and every Contraption and its upgrades.

chapters.title: Districts, Übercommanders and Side Missions
chapters.summary: Visiting Districts, the Enigma Machine, the Killboard, side missions, the Shooting Range, the Killhouse and Wolfstone 3D.

chapters.title: Combat Feats
chapters.summary: Takedowns, stealth kill streaks, hatchet throws, helmets and other one-off feats.

chapters.title: The Adventures of Gunslinger Joe
chapters.summary: Its story steps from Research Station Omega to Übercommander Metze, readables, gold, top difficulties and its challenges.

chapters.title: The Diaries of Agent Silent Death
chapters.summary: Its three targets, readables, gold, top difficulties and its Sacramento, Hollywood and Moon challenges.

chapters.title: The Deeds of Captain Wilkins
chapters.summary: Its story steps from the return to America to the Sun Gun, readables, gold, top difficulties and its challenges.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 612880. The Steam app list has a second app with the same name, 650500, whose schema is titled "Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus German Edition"; it was not used. StrategyWiki has no page under "Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus" or "Wolfenstein 2: The New Colossus" (both returned missing). wolfenstein.fandom.com has the page, with about 273 linked pages, including eleven "Chapter N - ..." pages and an "Episode Zero" page; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 13 of 80 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the story chapter; four of them ("Kick It" 23.0%, "I'm Machine Enough" 2.0%, "Taste of Your own Medicine" 8.1%, "Keep Playing" 47.3%) may be feats rather than story steps. The three add-on chapters are named from the achievement text; the achievements that do not name their add-on (for example "First Down", "Back in the Field", "Homecoming" and the per-location challenge achievements) were grouped by the places and targets they name and by their position next to the named ones in the Steam schema.
